name: compose-redeploy
description: 通用容器重部署：目录/编排文件核对 → 可选 git 快进 → compose 配置与 service 校验 → 重建服务 → 容器与 HTTP 健康断言 → 日志留档。产物怎么上去由项目决定（本文件只管编排与断言，脚本本体留在项目仓库）。

steps.description: 闸门：目录与编排文件必须存在
可选：仓库快进到 ${git_ref}（未提供则跳过）
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${git_ref}" ]; then
  echo 'git-skip（未提供 git_ref）'
else
  git -C "${app_dir}" fetch --all --prune
  git -C "${app_dir}" merge --ff-only "${git_ref}"
  echo "repo-head=$(git -C "${app_dir}" rev-parse --short HEAD)"
fi

steps.description: compose 配置语法有效；提供了 service 时必须在编排里存在
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
cd "${app_dir}"
docker compose -f "${compose_file}" config -q
echo compose-config-ok
if [ -n "${service}" ]; then
  docker compose -f "${compose_file}" config --services | grep -qx "${service}" || { echo "service-not-found ${service}" >&2; exit 5; }
  echo "compose-service-ok ${service}"
fi
echo compose-config-done

steps.description: 重建服务：给了 service 就走 --force-recreate --no-deps，否则只做 up -d
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
cd "${app_dir}"
if [ -n "${service}" ]; then
  docker compose -f "${compose_file}" up -d --force-recreate --no-deps "${service}"
else
  docker compose -f "${compose_file}" up -d
fi
echo compose-up-done

set -euo pipefail
if [ -n "${container_name}" ]; then
  docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "${container_name}" 2>/dev/null || { echo "container-missing ${container_name}" >&2; exit 6; }
  echo "container-ok ${container_name}"
else
  cd "${app_dir}"
  docker compose -f "${compose_file}" ps
  echo 'container-skip（未提供 container_name，已回显 compose ps）'
fi
echo compose-container-done

set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${health_url}" ]; then
  echo 'http-skip（未提供 health_url）'
else
  curl -fsSL -m 15 -w '\nhttp-code=%{http_code}\n' "${health_url}" | tail -n 1
fi
echo compose-http-done

steps.description: 日志尾部留档（可选：container_name，失败不影响结论）
steps.script:
set -u
if [ -z "${container_name}" ]; then
  echo 'logs-skip（未提供 container_name）'
else
  docker logs --tail 20 "${container_name}" 2>&1 | tail -n 20 || echo logs-unavailable
fi
